title: useUndoSimple Hook
description:
Implement a `useUndoSimple` hook that supports a single level of undo and returns `{ value, set, undo, canUndo }`. `set(newValue)` changes the value and saves the previous one. `undo()` reverts to the previous value. `canUndo` is `false` initially and after an undo.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { value, set, undo, canUndo } = useUndoSimple('hello');
```
ai_context: Common mistake: storing canUndo as a separate boolean state rather than deriving it from whether prev is defined — derived state stays in sync automatically and avoids inconsistency bugs.
